\textbf{Current executions.} The fresh source-release checker passed 20 exact tests containing 305,933 assertions and passed 16 verifier tests, including positive and negative controls. The expanded-source numerical audit passed 11,052 finite checks, mixing exact and numerical calculations. The new extension examples separately passed 38 grouped exact checks and four false controls. These counts measure different operations and are not combined as theorem counts.\par
\textbf{Reproducibility.} The package preserves the original sources and their reports. Run \texttt{python build.py} here for an isolated PDF build. The new finite checker is \texttt{checks/verify\_extension\_examples.py}; its contract and raw execution manifest are included. The original visual checker requires the listed optional dependencies. PDF assembly does not run Lean or either mathematical checker.
